Five different drivers won at least one race in the 2006 season.

The 2006 final standings list the win totals: Fernando Alonso 7, Michael Schumacher 7, Felipe Massa 2, Giancarlo Fisichella 1, and Jenson Button 1. Those add up to 18 wins, which matches the 18 rounds of the season. Every other driver in the standings is listed with 0 wins, including Kimi Räikkönen, who finished on the podium several times but never won.

ANSWER: 5
